completion_promises.criterion_text: `docker build -f study-tutor/Dockerfile --build-context nats-core=../nats-core -t study-tutor:dev ..` (from a parent directory containing both repos) succeeds without errors.
completion_promises.evidence: Dockerfile is laid out for the exact invocation in the AC: it consumes `--build-context nats-core=...` via `COPY --from=nats-core . /workspace/nats-core/`, places nats-core as a sibling of /workspace/study-tutor so [tool.uv.sources] path = '../nats-core' resolves, and copies study-tutor/pyproject.toml + uv.lock + src/ from the parent build context. uv is installed before the first `uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-install-project`, then src is copied and `uv pip install --no-deps -e .` registers the editable install. The end-to-end docker build + docker run evidence is operator-territory (no Docker daemon in this worktree); the runbook in TASK-NATS-PH3-004 captures the live build log. Structural correctness is gated locally by tests/unit/test_dockerfile_structure.py (13 tests, all passing).

completion_promises.criterion_text: `docker run --rm study-tutor:dev study-tutor serve-nats --help` shows the expected flag surface.
completion_promises.evidence: Default command is `CMD ["study-tutor", "serve-nats"]` (CMD, not ENTRYPOINT) so the AC's `docker run image study-tutor serve-nats --help` form fully overrides CMD and click sees a clean argv. PATH includes /workspace/study-tutor/.venv/bin so the console_script declared in pyproject.toml resolves. The serve-nats command (src/study_tutor/cli/main.py:625) defines --nats, --agent-id, --log-level, matching the coach validation grep `(--nats|--agent-id)`. Tests test_default_command_runs_serve_nats and test_path_includes_venv_bin enforce the wiring.

completion_promises.criterion_text: `docker run --rm study-tutor:dev which study-tutor` returns a valid path.
completion_promises.evidence: ENV PATH="/workspace/study-tutor/.venv/bin:${PATH}" makes the uv-managed venv's bin/ directory the first entry on PATH. `uv pip install --no-deps -e .` (after src/ is copied) registers the `study-tutor` console_script declared in pyproject.toml's [project.scripts]. Using CMD instead of ENTRYPOINT means `docker run image which study-tutor` is run verbatim and resolves to .venv/bin/study-tutor. Test test_path_includes_venv_bin guards the PATH wiring.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Image size is reasonable (< 800MB; track if it exceeds).
completion_promises.evidence: Base image is python:3.11-slim (~50MB) — same as specialist-agent which fits comfortably under 800MB with the same dep set. We minimize image size by: (a) using slim base, (b) `uv sync --frozen --no-dev` to exclude test/dev deps, (c) editable install (no duplicated source), (d) PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 + UV_LINK_MODE=copy. Actual `docker images` size measurement requires a Docker daemon and the sibling nats-core repo, which is not available in this worktree; that measurement is captured in the TASK-NATS-PH3-004 runbook. Marked uncertain rather than complete because the size number itself cannot be measured here.
